keys.level: Numeric source level; levelKind distinguishes stages, quantities, TH/BH and charges. Static items without levels have an empty levels array.
keys.cost: Number for one resource; array of numbers aligned with resource for multiple payments. Per upgrade, not cumulative. null means unavailable in source; N/A/None/free cost cells become 0.
keys.resource: Resource name or aligned array. payment=all means pay all; payment=any means alternatives. alternativeCosts lists optional Wall Ring payments.
keys.time: Original upgrade/build/research duration display; null means no duration supplied. Empty/N/A/None/Instant mean no timed upgrade.
keys.seconds: Integer duration in seconds; 0 for explicitly untimed values; null when time is absent.
keys.th: Minimum Town Hall for this row (Town Hall building upgrades require the previous TH). null means unknown.
keys.bh: Minimum Builder Hall, analogous to th.
keys.prerequisites: Other source requirements keyed by original column name; item requirements apply to all its levels. prerequisiteTables retain task/availability requirements.
keys.table: Zero-based source table index, preserving modules, modes and duplicate levels; table heading and notes are in item.tables. Do not sum alternate modes or historical charge tables.
keys.costNote: Explanation when source cost is variable or unavailable.
keys.costSourceTable: Table supplying upgrade fields for a stats-only alternate mode; do not charge for both rows.
keys.supportingTables: Source cost/availability tables without numeric levels.
keys.row: Zero-based source row index; compact l arrays use table=-1.
keys.levelKind: Source level column (or static construction); no inferred levels for non-upgradable items.
keys.hallMap: Source hallByLevel retained separately where it conflicts with explicit table requirements; explicit row hall takes precedence.
keys.notes: Source caveats, including unverified/reset/acquisition rules; no claim of independent game verification.
keys.boost: Super Troop boost metadata; level costs are BASE troop research, not an extra Super Troop upgrade.
keys.usage: Filter normal levels by th/bh and all prerequisites; honor removedAtTH. Sum incremental costs/times above current level along the same table/module. Respect alternative payments and acquisition rules.
